config.readoutSurgery: minimal regularized updates to existing decoder linear/residual output layers
config.selectionRule: A* preferred action first; sweep safe alternatives; bounded temporary regression is tentative; if a stall reveals an earlier frontier, rewind the tentative transaction to the last committed decoder and branch from that earlier state; commit only after score exceeds last committed score

interpretation: The full measured MaleCNS and V5 sensory/core policy remain frozen and active. Only the existing small motor readout output layers are minimally repaired. Terminal failures and long no-progress tails are both treated as repair frontiers. At each frontier the A* first action is preferred, but if that action is incompatible with the current closed-loop readout the script also evaluates every other immediately safe local action. For stalls, the earliest teacher disagreement in the current no-progress tail is repaired so the repeated blocked/waiting suffix is not protected. The update direction is projected into the exact nullspace of every earlier on-policy readout feature. Score-neutral or slightly score-negative tactical moves may be used only inside a bounded tentative bridge. If that branch stalls and stall analysis finds an error earlier than the first tentative surgery, the transaction is rewound to the last committed decoder and exploration restarts from that earlier frontier. This avoids stacking new readout edits on top of a branch whose prefix has just been rewritten. The bridge commits only after a later repair exceeds the last committed score; otherwise all tentative work is rolled back. Final success additionally requires a bounded no-progress streak and blocked-action rate.
